sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirementsFo: select psr.*, ot.operator_type, psrt.process_step_requirement_type, ps.id as parent_id, ps.process_step_name as parent_name, cf.field_name, cfn.company_function_name from flow.process_step_requirement psr left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = psr.custom_field_group_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt on cfgt.id = cfg.custom_field_group_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfgt.process_step_id left join flow.company_function cfn on cfn.id = psr.company_function_id inner join flow.operator_type ot on ot.id = psr.operator_type_id inner join flow.process_step_requirement_type psrt on psrt.id = psr.process_step_requirement_type_id where psr.archived is not true and psr.process_step_id = :processStepId order by psr.requirement_nbr
sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirement: select psr.*, ot.operator_type, psrt.process_step_requirement_type, ps.id as parent_id, ps.process_step_name as parent_name, cf.field_name, cfn.company_function_name from flow.process_step_requirement psr left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = psr.custom_field_group_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt on cfgt.id = cfg.custom_field_group_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfgt.process_step_id left join flow.company_function cfn on cfn.id = psr.company_function_id inner join flow.operator_type ot on ot.id = psr.operator_type_id inner join flow.process_step_requirement_type psrt on psrt.id = psr.process_step_requirement_type_id where psr.id = :id
sql.processStepRequirement.deleteRequirement: update flow.process_step_requirement set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :requirementId
sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirementTyp: select * from flow.process_step_requirement_type where archived is not true
sql.processStepRequirement.updateRequirement: update flow.process_step_requirement set operator_type_id = :operatorTypeId, requirement_value = :requirementValue, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepRequirement.insertRequirement: insert into flow.process_step_requirement(process_step_requirement_type_id, operator_type_id, requirement_value, custom_field_group_id, company_function_id, requirement_nbr, date_created, created_by_id, process_step_id) values (:requirementTypeId, :operatorTypeId, :requirementValue, :customFieldGroupId, :companyFunctionId, (select coalesce(max(requirement_nbr),0) + 1 from flow.process_step_requirement where process_step_id = :processStepId), now(), :createdById, :processStepId)
